Healing is not feeling better. It's understanding why you feel what you feel.

You think ignoring it will make it disappear.
But what you avoid doesn't leave — it hides.
And what stays hidden controls your reactions, moods, and patterns without your permission.

Small triggers feel bigger than they should.
Overthinking keeps you in the same loop.
The past doesn't stay in the past — it shows up in ways you don't notice.

This series will show you why — and how to actually heal.
